Package neqsim.mcp.runners

Class FluidDefaults

java.lang.Object
neqsim.mcp.runners.FluidDefaults
public final class FluidDefaults extends Object
Shared defaults for fluids built from MCP JSON input.

Every runner used to fall back to the "classic" mixing rule regardless of the equation of state. For CPA systems that selects the SRK binary-interaction database and silently gives wrong aqueous-phase results (a wet-gas hydrate temperature of about 0 C instead of 16 C at 100 bara). The decision lives in EosMixingRuleType.defaultForModel(String); this class adds the JSON convenience so a caller who omits mixingRule gets the rule the model was parameterised with, while an explicit value is always honoured.

      Parameters:
      model - model name such as SRK, PR, CPA, CPA-SRK, ELECTROLYTE-CPA (case-insensitive, may be null)
